question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word to fill in the blank in the sentence.**

**Rigid**

The new education scenario is not ______ but practical.
solution:
The correct answer is **"stiff."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Rigid"** means inflexible or stiff. (किसी को बदलने में असमर्थ या परिवर्तित होने का अनिच्‍छुक)

 
 
• **Example**:* I was **rigid**__ with fear.*
 
 
 
• **"Stiff"** means (used about material, paper, etc.) firm and difficult to bend or move. ((वस्‍तु, काग़ज़ आदि) सख्‍़त, कड़ा और न झुकने या मुड़ने वाला)
 __
 
• Example: *My new shoes feel rather **stiff**__.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the new education scenario is not inflexible, but practical.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate synonym to fill in the blank is **"stiff."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The new education scenario is not __**stiff**__ but practical.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "popular" **means liked by many people or by most people in a group. (लोकप्रिय, अधिकतर लोगों को पसंद)
 
• **Option 2, "dominating"**, means being the largest, most important, most noticeable, or the best person or thing. (सबसे बड़ा, सबसे महत्वपूर्ण, सबसे अधिक ध्यान देने योग्य, या सबसे अच्छा व्यक्ति या चीज़ होना)
 
• **Option 3, "flexible"**, means able to bend or move easily without breaking. (लचीला, लचकदार)
